dogecoin.text: In the words of @elonmusk, “#Dogecoin is a hustle,” which is a polite way of calling it a pump and dump scheme.

@elonmusk Why does Elon enjoy willfully manipulating the markets so much? First, he goes on #SNL and admits that #dogecoin is a hustle and, three days after the ensuing rout he asks his followers whether @Tesla should accept #doge. Surely this can’t be legal!
@ChairwomanDoge @elonmusk Who would have thought that investing in dogecoin (dog shįt) could put you in arrears on your housing payments.
